name: The (Red) Drum of War
source:
A red drum is slighted by a rival.  She seeks revenge.  It's stupid. 

[From [url=https://drone-garden-studios.itch.io/the-red-drum-of-war]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一条红鼓鱼遭死对头轻慢，决意展开复仇。整个故事蠢透了。

[摘自[url=https://drone-garden-studios.itch.io/the-red-drum-of-war]itch.io[/url]]
